newsitem.title: USA: Canadian March, April spot natgas prices hold.
newsitem.headline: Canadian March, April spot natgas prices hold.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were little changed Tuesday for both next-day and April business, as mild weather in the West dissuaded buyers from entering the marketplace.
At the AECO storage hub, prices for Wednesday delivery remained at C$1.50-1.52 per gigajoule (GJ) despite continued mild temperatures in Alberta.
Milder-than-normal weather is forecast to continue over the next few days, sources said, adding that it would likely lead to softer prices later this week.
April AECO prices were in convergence with March at C$1.50 per GJ, flat from March indices.
At Sumas, Wash., next-day prices edged about two cents higher to about $1.15-1.20 per million British thermal units (mmBtu).
April 1 deals were reported done mostly at $1.06-1.09 per mmBtu, down slightly from March indices.
At Niagara, prices for Wednesday delivery were talked around $2.15 per mmBtu, while April prices carried about a five-cent premium to March indices at $2.10-2.15.
